tenancy.title: Tenancy
tenancy.subtitle: Groups give several people one shared context; pools are named memory stores that agents bind with pool: <name>, opened to tenants by grants. Changes are live.
tenancy.meta: {groups, plural, one {# group} other {# groups}} ({active} active) · {pools, plural, one {# pool} other {# pools}}
tenancy.creator: Creator
tenancy.groups.empty: No groups. A group has one master and any number of members; a chat enters it with /group <uuid>.
tenancy.groups.selectHint: Select a group to manage its members.
tenancy.groups.enterUuid: Enter the tenant uuid to add.
tenancy.groups.removeMemberMessage: Remove {who} from "{name}"? Their turns stop acting in this group immediately.
tenancy.groups.disbandMessage: Disband "{name}"? Access ends now for every member; its rows are deleted when the disband retention elapses. This is done as the master ({master}).
tenancy.groups.membersSubtitle: A turn acts in the group only when the sender is an active member; the engine validates it, the route only proposes.
tenancy.groups.newSubtitle: Groups are recorded in the runtime store and are live immediately.
tenancy.groups.required: A name and a creator are required.
tenancy.groups.creatorHint: The creator's personal uuid. They become the master and the first member.
tenancy.pools.empty: No pools. Create one, grant agents access, then bind a store to it with pool: <name>.
tenancy.pools.selectHint: Select a pool to manage its grants.
tenancy.pools.created: pool {name} created · grant agents before binding it
tenancy.pools.bindStore: Bind a memory store to it: {binding}
tenancy.pools.bindStoreText: Bind a memory store to it: {binding}
tenancy.pools.grantsSubtitle: Per (agent, tenant). The member wildcard covers everyone active in the owning group; a tenant pool's wildcard covers nobody but its owner.
tenancy.pools.noGrants: No grants: no agent can read or write this pool yet.
tenancy.pools.retentionInvalid: Retention must be a positive number of days.
tenancy.pools.required: A name, a creator and an owner are required.
tenancy.pools.newSubtitle: A named shared store owned by exactly one tenant or group.
tenancy.pools.namesNote: Names are global and are what config stores bind to. Retention is immutable once set: extending it means a new pool.
